deterministic_guard.interpretation: The frozen outputs601 guard must return FALSE for this null address after logging RETURN. ownedbreak then fails and the debugger terminates its child. Later access violation is after TERMINATE, not evidence of the initiating game fault. Stale GetLastError121 does not identify the guard.
